name: AI Contract Diff
author: Knotarium
description: Compares two versions of a document by meaning and routes by whether anything material changed — the AI Semantic Diff node in one run. Byte-identical inputs short-circuit to 'none' with no model call; otherwise the model extracts the changes and deterministic code decides material vs cosmetic vs none. The bundled sample changes a delivery deadline, so a fresh run lands on the 'material' branch. Requires an AI provider under Settings → AI Provider.
